title: Mai Shaam jayungi
body:
Alwida beti sakina - 2
Baba haye baba
baba haye baba
mai shaam jaungi na tumhe chor ke tanha
mujhe rok lo baba - 2
Bas aaj se kadmo me hi so legi sakina
Muje roklo baba
1. miljaye jo maukha to karun sab ki niyadat
beti kahin bankar kahin hamsheer ki surat
royegi har ek laash pe ja ja ke ye dukhiya
<<MINI>>
mujhe rok lo babamai shaam jaungi....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bujh jayegi is tarha meri tashnadahani
pyaso ko tere naam pe pilwaungi pani
ghazi ki qasam aaj se banjaungi saqqa
<<MINI>>
mujhe rok lo babamai shaam jaungi....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Beto ka ada farz karegi teri beti
nazdik yaha se koi aabadi to hogi
laaungi kafan maangke logo se tumhara
muje roklo baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bejaan sahi saamne nazro ke hai mere
Maqtal me hai bikhre hue sab apno ke laashe
is dasht me aabaad hai baba meri duniya
muje rokle baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. manzar wo takallum ka qalam likh nahi sakta
jab shimr ne bachi ko juda sheh se kiya tha
kehti rahi shabbir se mud mud ke sakina
mujhe rok lo baba
